# TryRevive offline speech vendor boundary

`windows-x64/` is generated by `npm run speech:install` and is intentionally not committed.

The installer downloads only these pinned upstream artifacts and verifies SHA-256 before use:

- `ggml-org/whisper.cpp` `v1.9.1`, official `whisper-bin-x64.zip`;
- `ggerganov/whisper.cpp` model revision `5359861c739e955e79d9a303bcbc70fb988958b1`, `ggml-base-q5_1.bin`.

The Windows package includes the verified runtime and model so user recordings can be transcribed
offline without an API key. Audio is written only to a TryRevive-created temporary WAV and is
deleted after transcription. The generated directory must never contain user recordings.

See `LICENSE-whisper.cpp.txt` and `LICENSE-openai-whisper.txt` in this directory.
